{{Quote|All these Jedi artifacts&hellip;our history&hellip;this is ''priceless''!|Shado Vao|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 11">[[Legacy (2006) 11|''Legacy'' (2006) 11]]</ref>}}
'''Jedi artifacts''', sometimes known as '''Jedi treasures''', were priceless [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] [[Force artifact/Legends|items]], ancient in their creation but invaluable to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for their potency and unique interaction with the light side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Jedi artifacts included Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], ancient Jedi [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], [[Jedi Credit]]s, Jedi scrolls or books, and even ancient [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], to name a few.
